scope: Complete renderer ParseHtmlTag tokenization, attribute order, style mutations, closing-tag semantics and karaoke updates in safe Rust, with copied Windows CRT services.

operations.behavior: Comment prefix exits immediately. Closing flag reads the original first unit before trim. TrimRight scans the first-NUL prefix; a trailing match truncates all later data. TrimLeft shifts the stored suffix, retaining post-NUL units if no right truncation occurred. Find uses first-NUL search but missing delimiters use stored length. Ordered attribute names/values are trimmed and lowered before style mutation.

Preserve text no-op, b/strong weight700, i/em, u and s/strike/del flags with closing restores. Font names retain lowercased raw units. Relative negative size subtracts a signed negative wcstol value and may increase size. Duplicate attributes apply in order. Closingfont resets only name,size and4colors, leaving alpha and outline/shadow widths intact. Color operations reuse validated shared Rust logic. Unknown tags refuse without style/karaoke mutation.

Only k with exactly1attribute namedt is accepted. Setkind1, copypriorend tostart, then add wcstol10 with wrappingi32. Empty values still convert as in reference; duplicate/extra attributes refuse. State is supplied and returned as scalar bits.

Native signed32bit number converts exactly to f64. Addition/subtraction and direct assignment keep reference ordering. Existing full style wire preserves unmodified double bits; tests include finite23.5, negativezero, positiveinfinity and quietNaN0x7ff8123456789abc.

CString MakeLower is _wcslwr_s with original length+1, unlike BSTR CharLowerBuffW. Rust copies a terminated buffer, ignores result like CString, then retains the original stored length including post-NUL units. IsSpace uses Windows iswspace on16bit units. Numeric services retain wcstol locale/errno behavior. All services run outside registry admission/native gates.

boundary_review.contract: Stateless byte packet contains rawtag,2complete192byte-header style records and3karaoke scalars. Counts and overflow are checked; reply capacity covers max(tag,currentfont,originalfont) before parsing. Output contains accepted,3karaoke scalars,actualstyle length and complete style bytes. Input/output may overlap; no borrowed native storage survives into CRT calls. Output is never read, and failures leave it untouched. Native shim only transports/materializes values.

unsafe_delta.note: Two of the4blocks are Windows lowercase/whitespace service calls.

boundary_review.tests: Trim/NUL preservation and truncation, lowercased rawfont, negative size, closing flag beforetrim, closingfont subset, comment preserving NaN bits, duplicatekaraoke refusal, wrapping state, complete packet bounds, invalidstyle bool, oversize/null counts, uninitialized output and buffer overlap.

direct_probe.coverage: 44literal tags +7attributes x22values x2quoted/unquoted +264rawcodeunits x4positions =1408inputs, each with4floatingpoint/karaoke seeds. Additional12-tag sequences run twice for eachseed=96stateful calls. Original and current full style snapshots, accepted flag, errno and3karaoke fields captured after every call.
direct_probe.method: Actual selected linked renderer private method and private karaoke fields accessed with explicitly instantiated member addresses; no implementation or access/layout rewrite. Two reference and two candidate executions per architecture; all traces must also equal pre-port baseline.

limits: Experimental document-owner path only. No production switch or complete renderer/host/library claim.

Windows iswspace, _wcslwr_s and wcstol remain system CRT services through audited Rust FFI. Native STSStyle/CString marshaling and renderer field storage remain transitional; no native parser decisions remain on the experimental ParseHtmlTag path.

Finite Unicode Windows MSVC14.44 x86/x64 evidence. No claim for allocator/new-handler reentry, injected faults, arbitrary locale changes, uninitialized input style fields, non-Unicode builds or non-Windows renderer behavior.

Input pointer validity and output writable capacity remain unsafe FFI preconditions. Packet counts, complete style shapes, representations and reply capacity are checked before platform services; output is staged after input copying and parsing.
Lexical unsafe counts are an inventory rather than soundness proof or migration percentage. Crashes/hangs/nondeterminism remain unresolved; previous evidence retains original provenance.
